topics.label: Course introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, its multidisciplinary audience, and the session's core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Biological foundations and modeling of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the fundamental view of cancer as a progressive failure of cellular differentiation, genetic regulation, and tissue architecture, alongside the experimental systems used to study it.

topics.label: Tumor invasion, metastasis, and malignant progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the histological and clinical distinctions between benign and malignant tumors, focusing on the mechanisms and stepwise pathways of tissue invasion and metastatic spread.

topics.label: Conventions and exceptions in tumor nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard linguistic rules and notable exceptions used to classify and name benign and malignant neoplasms across various tissue types.

topics.label: Pathological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical and physiological processes through which primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic disease and patient death.

topics.label: Comparative incidence and evolutionary scope of tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine cancer frequency across human populations and demonstrate that tumor development is a universal feature of multicellular animal life.

topics.label: Clinical principles, practices, and limitations of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, diagnostic techniques, and relative effectiveness of early tumor detection and screening programs across different anatomical sites.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and practical instructions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing, directing students to review key learning outcomes and prepare for subsequent practical work.
